headline: Goals are destinations you choose—clarity about what you want enables movement toward it
universal_truth: You can't hit a target you haven't set; knowing what you want is the first step to getting it
fun_facts: People who write down goals are 42% more likely to achieve them
The brain's reticular activating system filters information to notice goal-relevant opportunities
Specific goals lead to 90% better performance than vague intentions
discussion_questions: What do you actually want—specifically, not vaguely?
How clear are your goals? Could you measure progress?
What would you do differently if you had crystal clarity about your destination?

hook.title: Welcome
hook.script: You can't Google directions without entering a destination. You can't reach a target you haven't set. Goals are chosen destinations—clarity about what you want. Without them, you're just wandering.

options.text: I want to learn something new
options.response: Perfect. Curiosity is the first step to understanding. Let's explore this together.
That curiosity is exactly what we need. Let's dive in and discover something amazing.

cliff.title: The Question
cliff.script: Many people have vague wishes but not real goals. What's the difference, and why does it matter?

options.text: Effective goals are specific and measurable—vague desires provide no direction; clear targets let you navigate, measure progress, and know when you've arrived
options.response: Yes. 'Get fit' is a wish. 'Run a 5K by June' is a goal. Specificity enables planning, measurement, and course-correction. Clarity creates possibility.

options.text: Goals are just things you want
options.response: Wants are the start, but goals require clarity, specificity, and commitment...

q1.title: Specificity Enables
q1.script: Vague goals get vague results. 'Do better' offers no direction. 'Increase sales by 10% this quarter' creates a path. Specificity transforms wishes into achievable targets.
q1.prompt: What's your first impression of "Specificity Enables"?

options.text: This confirms what I already knew
options.response: Great foundation! Now let's build on that knowledge with something you might not expect...
Perfect starting point! This insight will connect to even more surprising facts ahead.

q2.title: Filtering Function
q2.script: Clear goals activate your brain's filtering system. You start noticing relevant opportunities that were always there but invisible. Clarity changes what you see.
q2.prompt: How does this connect to what you already know?

options.response: Exactly. These connections are how knowledge becomes understanding.

options.text: I need to think about this more
options.response: That's a good instinct. Deep understanding takes time. The next fact will help clarify.

q3.title: The Courage to Choose
q3.script: Setting a goal means choosing—and not choosing everything else. This takes courage. But not choosing doesn't avoid choice; it just chooses by default. Decide deliberately.
q3.prompt: What surprises you most about this?

options.text: I never thought about it this way
options.response: That shift in perspective is exactly the point. New angles reveal new truths.
That's learning in action. When understanding shifts, you're really getting it.

wisdom.title: Today's Wisdom
wisdom.script: Here's today's wisdom: You can't hit a target you haven't set. Knowing what you want is the first step to getting it. Choose your destination.
wisdom.prompt: What resonates most with you today?

options.response: That central truth will stay with you. Let it guide your thinking.
Application is where knowledge becomes wisdom. That's the real learning.

outro.title: See You Tomorrow
outro.script: That's Day 283. Tomorrow, we'll explore things you do without thinking—habits. Until then, get specific about what you actually want.
outro.prompt: Before you go—what will you take from today?

options.response: Reflection deepens learning. Let these ideas simmer in your mind.
Teaching others is the best way to learn. You've already begun the ripple.

growTrack.title: Goal Clarity Exercise - What Do You Actually Want?
growTrack.learning_objective: Convert vague wishes into specific goals
growTrack.activity: Pick one thing you 'want.' Now make it specific: What exactly? By when? How will you measure it? How will you know you've arrived? Transform a wish into a goal you can actually pursue.
